decision_kind.description: The calibrated decision kind, covered by declaration_digest.

declaration_digest.description: SHA-256 over the decision kind, the listed roles in their declared order with their qualification digests and forms, and the score; equals the file name, and the record is valid only while they are unchanged.

roles.description: The configuration of every listed role at the calibration, in declared order.

items_graded.description: The corpus items tagged decision-kind:<kind> that were graded.

auto_share.description: Percent of the graded items the declaration would decide automatically.

false_auto_share.description: Percent of the automatically decided items that disagree with the reference; 0 when none was decided automatically.

constant_baseline.description: Percent of the graded items whose target is the most frequent target option (model-work/10, Quorum Calibration).

false_auto.description: decided and the agreed option is neither the item's target answer nor an accepted alternative.

total_tokens.description: The tokens the item used (store-schemas/05, Metrics Store).

tokens_in.description: The split the view shows: input, cache read and cache creation; measured as a pair with tokens_out summing to total_tokens, or unmeasured when the item's split is.

tokens_out.description: The split the view shows: output and reasoning; measured as a pair with tokens_in summing to total_tokens, or unmeasured when the item's split is.

form.description: The form the role's vote tasks ran in at the calibration.

qualification_digest.description: The role's qualification digest at the calibration (Role Qualification Record).

harness.description: The harness of the qualification record the digest names.
